methods.description: Read common-unit length and width, multiply and give square units; a square uses the same side twice.
Calculate each rectangle area, including changed dimensions, then compare and state the difference or factor if asked.
Use common length units to find whole tiles along each side and multiply the number per row by the rows.
Calculate rectangle area, then divide by the given area covered by one litre.
